name: Graven Hold

civilization.name: The Kethari Collective
civilization.notes: Once a thriving industrial society spanning three continents, the Kethari now cling to a handful of smog-choked city-states. Centuries of unchecked resource extraction have poisoned their rivers and stripped their forests, leaving a civilization in slow collapse.

specific_features: Vast industrial ruins stretching across dead plains
Perpetual smog layer visible from orbit
Canal networks choked with chemical runoff
description: Graven Hold is a terrestrial world scarred by centuries of industrial exploitation. Its once-verdant continents are now patchworks of stripped earth, slag heaps, and thinning forests clinging to the margins of poisoned watersheds.

The atmosphere remains technically breathable, but a persistent haze of particulate matter dims the sun to a pale bronze disc. The air carries a faint metallic taste, and acid rain has etched strange patterns into exposed stone across the northern hemisphere.

The Kethari Collective rose to dominance through mastery of steam and metallurgy, building vast factory-cities connected by iron rail. But their success devoured the very world that sustained them, and now their population dwindles as crop failures and respiratory disease take their toll.

Graven Hold presents a grim case study in civilizational overshoot. Xenoanthropologists debate whether outside intervention could reverse the decline, while salvage crews eye the planet's abandoned industrial infrastructure as a source of bulk metals and machine components.
